zh: 就在这时候，到了一班客人，领头的是跷脚长根，其次是俞武成，再后面就是尤五跟他的那班江湖弟兄，殿尾的是杨凤毛和朱老大，挤得满满的一屋子，加上妙珍领着娘姨、大姐来招呼，乱得不可开交。“小爷叔！”尤五避开古应春和刘不才，将他一拉，悄悄说道，“我有几句要紧话，想跟你说。看哪里有清静的地方？”这里找主人，胡雪岩便又去问妙珍，她毫不迟疑地答道：“妙珠的房间空着。”“不错！”胡雪岩倒想起来了，“妙珠是怎么回事？”听此一问，妙珍的神情很奇怪，瞟了他一眼，用又象埋怨，又象调侃的声音说，“我都要问胡老爷是怎么回事？”这样一扯开来，话就说不完了，事虽关心，苦于此时无暇深问，胡雪岩只说得一句：“回头再谈！”转身而去。将尤五领到妙珠原来的住处，进房便觉异样。古应春睡过的那张大铜床，裳枕皆已收起，只剩下一张藤棚，妆台上胭脂花粉，一扫而空，玻璃镜子上还蒙了个布套子，格外有股人去楼空，天涯何处的凄凉味道。“唉！”胡雪岩不知不觉地轻轻叹了口气。尤五一天都在忙着商谈“大事”，布解所谓，便愕然相问：“小爷叔，你叹啥气？”胡雪岩是深感于这短短一天之中，妙珠由一念轻生到毅然脱出风尘。已经历了好一番沧桑，情动乎中，不能自已，但到底算是闲情，这时候何必去谈它？所以问而不答，只说：“你们今天跟长根谈得怎么样？”
en: Just then a party arrived, led by Changgen, followed by Yu Wucheng, then You Laowu and his fellow men of the brotherhood, with Yang Fengmao and Zhu bringing up the rear. The room was packed. Miaozhen and her maids hurried to attend them, adding to the confusion. Drawing Hu away from Gu and Liu, You whispered, “Little Uncle, I have something important to discuss. Where can we find somewhere quiet?” Hu asked Miaozhen, who answered at once, “Miaozhu's room is empty.” “Of course! That reminds me. What's happened to her?” Miaozhen gave him an odd glance. Her voice was half reproachful, half teasing. “I should be asking what's happened to you, Master Hu.” Once begun, that conversation would never end. Concerned though he was, Hu had no time to inquire. “We'll discuss it later,” he said, and turned away. He took You to Miaozhu's former room and felt the difference as soon as he entered. The bedding and pillows had been removed from the great brass bed where Gu had slept, leaving only its rattan base. The cosmetics had vanished from the dressing table; even the mirror was covered with cloth. Everything spoke of the desolation of an empty room whose occupant had gone, who knew where. Unconsciously, Hu sighed. You had spent the day discussing important business and knew nothing of this. “Why are you sighing, Little Uncle?” Hu was moved by all Miaozhu had undergone in a single day, from attempting to end her life to firmly leaving the courtesan's world. But these were private feelings. Why speak of them now? He answered only, “How did your talks with Changgen go?”

zh: “那是小事。长根自然是厉害角色，不过自己人面前，不作兴说‘法兰西话’……”“ 什么？”胡雪岩打断他的话问：“你说什么‘话’！”“喔，”尤五笑道：“这是最近夷场里流行的一句俗语。说洋文，英国话还有人懂，法兰西语，只听他舌头上打滚，不晓得他说些什么？所以说人自说自话，彼此永远谈不拢，就说他是说‘法兰西话’。”“这倒也妙。长根不说‘法兰西话’，说的什么话呢？”“说的老实话，人心都是肉做的。小爷叔这样待他，他不能做半吊子。又说：吃不穷，着不穷，不长眼睛一世穷！这句话也很实在。大家都看上小爷叔了！“尤五用极郑重的语气说：”小爷叔，江南江北的漕帮，以后都要靠你老人家了！““言重，言重！”胡雪岩大为诧异，“怎么扯得这句话？”“我们商量好了！”尤五慢吞吞他说：“我们大家推小爷叔，做个军师，请你来发号施令。小爷叔，你不要打岔，听我讲完。”讲的是他们江南江北漕帮的一条自救自保之策。从洪杨起事，河道阻塞，漕米改为海运以后，漕帮生计维艰，只是遍地烽火，各地纷纷办团练自保，朝廷焦头烂额，只顾军务，尚且不暇，自然无法来管漕帮的生计。这层苦衷，漕帮的头脑，无不体谅，因此各地帮口小弟兄闹事，他们都是好言相劝，共体时艰，但朝天一张口，家家有老小，总得要喂饱肚子才行。这就不是苦口婆心的劝导所能济事的。因此，尤五、俞武成、跷脚长根还有另外一班漕帮管事的人物，人同此心，心同此理，都觉得唯一的办法是自己来寻一条生路。“小爷叔！大家都佩服你是天下第一等的脑筋，这条生路，不但要你替我们来寻，而且要请你领我们来走。”
en: “That was a small matter. He's formidable, of course, but among our own people he mustn't speak ‘French’.” “What?” Hu interrupted. “What language?” You laughed. “It's a saying recently current in the settlement. Some people understand English, but when a man speaks French, you only hear his tongue rolling and have no idea what he's saying. So when someone talks only to suit himself and neither side can ever agree, we call it speaking French.” “A good expression. If Changgen wasn't speaking French, what was he speaking?” “Plain truth. Everyone has a heart. After the way you've treated him, he can't behave like a fool. He also said, ‘Food won't make you poor, nor will clothes; a lack of judgement will keep you poor all your life.’ That's sound enough. We all look to you now.” His tone became solemn. “Little Uncle, from now on the Grain Transport Brotherhood north and south of the Yangtze will depend on you.” “You honour me too much!” Hu was astonished. “How does that follow?” “We've discussed it.” You spoke slowly. “We all want you as our strategist, to give us our direction. Don't interrupt. Let me finish.” He described a plan for the brotherhood's survival. Since the rising of Hong and Yang had blocked the waterways and grain tribute had been diverted to sea transport, its members had struggled to make a living. War raged everywhere, local militias were forming for self-defence, and the court could scarcely cope with military affairs, much less attend to the brotherhood's livelihood. Its leaders understood these difficulties. Whenever junior members caused trouble, they urged them patiently to endure the hard times together. But every household had mouths to feed, old people and children alike. Kind advice alone could not fill empty stomachs. You, Yu, Changgen and other leaders had therefore reached the same conclusion: they must find a livelihood for themselves. “Everyone admires your intelligence as the finest in the world, Little Uncle. You must not only find us a path, but lead us along it.”

zh: “啊！”胡雪岩吸着气，已感到双肩沉重不胜了，但是，无论如何说不出拒绝的话来，只有三个字：想办法！当然，尤五与他的同道，亦决不会仅仅定下这么一个宗旨，便将千斤重担，不问青红皂白，压在胡雪岩肩上，他们也谈到过许多能够走、走得通的路。不过，这些想头，也大都是胡雪岩的启发而已。“小爷叔，我们也谈过，第一，漕帮有船有人，不运漕粮，可以运别的东西，甚至于载客。现在难民多，有时要搭船觅个铺位，还真不容易。你说，这行生意好不好做？”“当然好做。难处是怕官府不准。这，我来想办法。”“对啊！”尤五十分欣慰，“我们要请小爷叔来出头，就是这些关节，都要仰仗大力来打通。”“打不打得通，还不敢说。”胡雪岩又问：“你们还谈些什么生意，”“丝、茶两项销洋庄，现在看样子是一定可以恢复的了。我们想集一笔资本，请小爷叔替我们来做。”“这当然可以。不过我先要问一问，这两项生意，赚了钱，是私人的，还是公众的。”这话问得尤五一愣，“是啊！”他搔搔头皮说，“我倒没有想到这一点，现在是请小爷叔来替漕帮弟兄想办法，如果赚钱公众分，当然没话说。不然，就只好搁在后头了。”“我也是这个意思。五哥，”胡雪岩迟延了一下，终于问了出来，“我倒要请教，你的意思，是为公，还是……”“我的情形，你晓得的，无所谓公私。有钱，老太爷的用度先提起一份，此外就是大家用，手长的多用几个，脚慢的少用几个。”“这不是办法，你总要定个章程出来。不要说你是一帮之主，就是我自己的生意，对伙计们也要一碗水往平处端，大家才会心服，”“是！小爷叔说得是。”尤五深深点头。“这件事你不妨请老古替你参赞。现在不必会谈它。丝、茶两项生意，当然要做的，不过应该还有别的，大家有饭吃的生意好做。等我空一空来替你们动脑筋。”
en: Hu drew a breath, already feeling the crushing weight on his shoulders. Yet he could not refuse. He could only find a way. Naturally, You and his companions had not merely adopted a grand aim and thrust the whole burden on him. They had discussed several possible courses, though most were inspired by Hu's own ideas. “First, we have boats and men. If we can't carry tribute grain, we can carry other goods, even passengers. There are so many refugees now that finding a berth can be difficult. Wouldn't that be good business?” “Certainly. The difficulty is whether the authorities will permit it. I'll try to find a way.” “Exactly!” You was delighted. “That's why we want you to lead us. We need your help to clear those obstacles.” “I can't promise they can be cleared. What other businesses did you discuss?” “Exports of silk and tea seem certain to recover. We thought of pooling capital and asking you to trade for us.” “That is possible. But first, would the profits belong to individuals or to the whole body?” You was taken aback. “True. I hadn't considered that. We're asking you to find a livelihood for our brothers. If the profits are shared by everyone, naturally there's no objection. Otherwise that business must wait.” “That's my view too.” Hu hesitated, then asked, “Brother Five, are your own intentions public or...” “You know my situation. There's no distinction between public and private. When there's money, I first set aside the Old Master's expenses. The rest is for everyone. Those who reach farther take more; those who move slowly take less.” “That won't do. You must establish rules. Never mind being the leader of a branch—even in my own business I must treat the employees fairly if I want them sincerely to accept things.” You nodded earnestly. “You're right.” “Ask Old Gu to advise you on that. We needn't discuss it now. We should certainly trade in silk and tea, but there must be other businesses that can provide food for everyone. When I have some leisure, I'll think them through for you.”

zh: “是的。我先跟你说明白了，回头席面上，他们还有话说。”这一夜的盛宴，算是漕帮公众特请，虽非鸿门宴，但这顿饭也着实难吃，大家越是恭维，胡雪岩越觉责任沉重。所以一面谦虚，一面腹中寻思：江湖上行事，有时要“充”，不会的也得要大包大揽，满口答应，有时要“冲”，不管做得到做不到，硬做了去。但是，有时既不能充，更不能冲，一要诚实，二要稳健。象此时的情形，充对了、冲过了，未见得见好，充不好、冲不过，则误人大事，吃力而不讨好，不智之甚！因此，他等大家的话告一段落，从容冷静他说道：“刚才尤五哥跟我说，承各位台爱，我说不出推辞的话来。此刻想想，有两句话，一定先要向各位说明白。”这不能不预先声明的两点苦衷是：第一，他个人的生意，以及招揽在身上的闲事很多，而且也都到了不容再拖，必须料理的时候，所以一时还无法为漕帮效劳，其次，他感叹着说：“做事容易做人难”，将来必不能尽如人意，希望大家谅解。对于第一点，自是同声应承，提到第二点，尽管他措词委婉，仍有好些人觉得不安，尤其是俞武成，很费劲地申述，大家决没有任何成见，希望他不要多心。胡雪岩对“麻布筋多，光棍心多”这句江湖上人人皆知的谚语，深具戒心，所以本来还想在这方面再发挥几句的，见此光景，也只好缄口不言了。这一顿酒吃下来，已是斗转参横，除掉跷脚长根，其余都回到朱家歇宿。
en: “Good. I wanted to explain first. The others will have more to say at dinner.” That night's banquet was given expressly by the brotherhood as a whole. It was no trap, yet the meal was hard to endure. The more they praised Hu, the heavier his responsibility felt. As he answered modestly, he reflected that sometimes a man moving in their world had to put on a bold front, promising everything even beyond his ability. Sometimes he had to charge ahead, whether he could accomplish a thing or not. But sometimes neither pretence nor a headlong charge would do: honesty must come first, steadiness second. This was such an occasion. Even if he carried off the bluff or forced his way through, he might gain little credit. If he failed, he would ruin important affairs for others and earn only blame for his efforts. That would be folly. When their speeches ended, he spoke calmly. “Brother You has explained your wishes. You honour me so greatly that I cannot refuse. But there are two things I must make clear first.” First, his own business and the many other affairs he had undertaken had reached a point where further delay was impossible. He could not immediately devote himself to the brotherhood. Second, he sighed, “Doing the work is easier than dealing with people.” He could not hope to satisfy everyone and asked for their understanding. They all readily accepted the first point. The second, however tactfully expressed, made several uneasy. Yu in particular laboured to assure him that nobody harboured any prejudice and that he must not suspect them. Hu was wary of the familiar saying, “Hemp has many fibres; worldly men have many suspicions.” He had meant to say more on the subject, but now held his tongue. By the time the drinking ended, the stars had wheeled far across the sky. Everyone except Changgen returned to the Zhu house to sleep.

zh: 尤五因为同里事毕，而松江、上海都还有许多事要等他去料理，决定第二天一早离去，特地到胡雪岩那里话别。 不想一谈起来就没有完，胡雪岩一再催促，他总舍不得走，话虽多，其实以后有机会再谈亦可以，只是久别重逢，乍逢又别，觉得依依不舍而已。就这样一谈谈到夭亮，尤五索性直接上船，睡到松江。由于有他的朋友在一起，胡雪岩在礼节上不能不送行。河千握别，人已疲乏不堪，正待回朱家蒙头大睡，在一起的古应春眼尖，拉了他一把，急急说：“你看！”注目看时，一顶小轿，如飞而过，只从两方镶嵌的玻璃小窗中，看出是个女人，却不辨是何面貌。“是哪个？”“还有哪个？”古应春笑道：“请问在同里，还有哪个女人是小爷叔你关心的？”这当然是指妙珠，但古应春这样硬指他对妙珠关心，却使他感到有口难辩的委屈。就在这苦笑无以为答之际，只见轿子已转入一条小巷，他便脱口问了一句：“昨天搬出去以后，不知道她住在哪里？”“也许就住在这条巷子里。”古应春怂恿着说：“去看看！”拉着走到巷口一望，果不其然，轿子已经停了下来。胡雪岩心想，既已如此，不如看个明白，因而不必古应春相劝，先就走了过去。到那里一看，首先触入眼帘的是，一幅簇新的朱笺，写着乌光闪亮的两个径尺大字：“胡寓”。胡雪岩大为诧异，“老古，老古！”他慌慌张张地问：“妙珠也姓胡？”“我不晓得。”“这就有点奇怪了！”胡雪岩狐疑满腹，“这样‘霸玉硬上弓’的事！我还是第一回看见。回去倒要问问妙珍！“
en: With the Tongli business finished and much still awaiting him in Songjiang and Shanghai, You decided to leave early next morning. He came especially to say goodbye to Hu, but once they began talking there was no end to it. Hu repeatedly urged him to go, yet he was reluctant to leave. There would be other chances to say all this; they had simply met again after a long separation and hated to part so soon. They talked until dawn. You decided to board at once and sleep on the way to Songjiang. Since his friends were travelling with him, courtesy obliged Hu to see them off. After their handclasps by the river, Hu was exhausted and ready to return to Zhu's and bury himself in bed. Gu, beside him, caught his arm. “Look!” A small sedan chair swept past. Through its two glass windows Hu could see a woman, but not her face. “Who is it?” “Who else?” Gu smiled. “What other woman in Tongli concerns you?” He plainly meant Miaozhu. Hu felt unfairly cornered by the insistence that he cared for her. Before he could find an answer to accompany his rueful smile, the chair turned into a lane. “Where did she move to yesterday?” he blurted out. “Perhaps this very lane. Let's see.” Gu drew him to its entrance. Sure enough, the chair had stopped. Since they were there, Hu thought he might as well see for himself, and needed no further urging. The first thing he saw was a new sheet of scarlet paper bearing two enormous, shining black characters: “Hu Residence”. “Old Gu!” he asked in alarm. “Is Miaozhu's surname Hu too?” “I don't know.” “This is strange! Such high-handed compulsion—I've never seen the like. I must ask Miaozhen when we get back.”

zh: “何必那么费事？现在有妙珠在这里，为啥不问？”说着，古应春伸手便去叩门，胡雪岩想要阻止，已是不及，古应春拉起铜环“当当”地拍了两下。黑漆双扉开启，垂鬟小婢正是妙珠身边的小大姐阿金。“胡老爷！”面团团象“无锡大阿福”的阿金，笑嘻嘻他说：“你莫非千里眼、顺凤耳？一早就寻得来了。”胡雪岩无心跟她逗笑，只问：“二小姐呢？”“刚刚回来。”一句话不曾完，妙珠已掀帘而出，布衣布裙，屏绝铅华，已俨然“人家人”的样子了。“古老爷，”她含笑迎客：“请里面坐。”说着，抛给胡雪岩一个眼风，作为“尽在不言中”的招呼。这样的举止，是以胡家的主妇自居，胡雪岩心想：这就不必再问她的本姓了。如今要动脑筋的是，设法让她将“胡寓”这张朱笺取消。这样盘算着，便声色不动他说：“你这房子，倒不错。难为你觅得着，说搬就搬，一搬就有合适的房子，倒真凑巧。”“是啊，巧得很！”妙珠很高兴他说，“我领你们看看。”于是从前到后，走了一遍，最后到客堂落座。家具似是现成有在那里的，屋角堆着箱笼什物，还未整理。“今天还乱糟糟的，没有地方坐。古老爷，你下次来就好了。”妙珠又说，“做丝生意，总少不得要到同里来，如果没有地方落脚，就住在这里好了。这里，古老爷，你当它自己的家一样。”“多谢，多谢。”古应春说，“如果到同里，一定来看你。”
en: “Why go to that trouble? Miaozhu is here. Why not ask her?” Before Hu could stop him, Gu lifted the brass ring and knocked twice. The black-lacquered doors opened. The maid with hanging hair was A’jin, Miaozhu's attendant. Her round face looked like one of Wuxi's plump clay dolls, and she greeted them with a smile. “Master Hu! Have you eyes that see a thousand li and ears that hear on the wind? You've found us so early.” Hu had no wish to joke. “Where is Second Miss?” “Just back.” Before she finished, Miaozhu lifted the curtain and appeared. In a plain cloth jacket and skirt, without cosmetics, she already looked like a woman of a respectable household. “Mr Gu, please come in.” She smiled and cast Hu a glance in greeting, as though everything between them went without saying. She was taking the position of mistress of the Hu household. There was no need to ask her surname now. The problem was how to persuade her to remove that notice. Keeping his expression unchanged, Hu said, “A good house. Clever of you to find it. You decide to move, and at once there's a suitable place. What a coincidence.” “Yes, very fortunate! Let me show you.” She led them from front to back, then seated them in the reception room. The furniture seemed to have come with the house; trunks and other belongings still stood unpacked in the corners. “It's all in disorder today, with nowhere to sit. Next time will be better, Mr Gu. The silk trade must bring you to Tongli. If you need somewhere to stay, come here. Treat it as your own home.” Gu thanked her. “Whenever I come to Tongli, I'll certainly visit.”

zh: 修行的话也不说起了！胡雪岩心里好笑，想挖苦她两句，又怕她动气，便忍住了。但嘴角掩不住那种近乎捉住人错处的笑容，使得妙珠忍不住要问。“胡老爷，你笑啥。笑我做事顾前不顾后，是不是？”“顾前不顾后”五个字，不堪寻味，胡雪岩却不说破，只问：“你这房子是租，是典，还是买的？”“租的，”“房东卖不卖？”“卖也可以谈。”“看样子，你倒象很中意这所房子。”胡雪岩略停一下说：“我看为了省事，我就买这所房子给你好了。”“随你的意思。”“照我的意思，你先把‘胡寓’这张条子拿掉？”“不！”妙珠断然拒绝，“我姓胡，为啥不能贴那张条子？”“你将来不是要改做家庵吗……”“对，”妙珠抢着说道，“那时再换一张条子，叫做‘胡氏家庵’。”“那也随你的便。反正天下姓胡的多得很，随你高兴姓啥就姓啥。”依然是拒人千里的语气，妙珠觉得他太过于簿情，脸色便有些不大好看了。
en: There was no more talk of religious devotion! Hu was inwardly amused. He wanted to tease her but feared angering her and restrained himself. Still, he could not quite suppress the smile of a man who had caught someone out. “What are you laughing at?” she asked. “That I act without thinking ahead?” Those words invited reflection, but Hu did not pursue them. “Is this house rented, held under a redeemable transfer, or bought?” “Rented.” “Would the landlord sell?” “We could discuss it.” “You seem very fond of it.” He paused. “To save trouble, I might as well buy it for you.” “As you wish.” “Then first take down the ‘Hu Residence’ notice.” “No.” Her refusal was firm. “My surname is Hu. Why shouldn't I put it up?” “Weren't you going to turn the place into a private nunnery?” “Exactly. Then I'll replace it with ‘Hu Family Nunnery’.” “As you please. There are plenty of people called Hu. Call yourself whatever you like.” Again his words held her at a distance. She felt he was being too cold, and her face darkened.

zh: 胡雪岩神思困倦，肝火上升，认为妙珠过于惫赖，有意想跟她吵一架，吵散了拉倒。但未及开口，为古应春看出端倪，急忙抢在前面做和事佬。“啊！”他故意装作耽误大事，突然想起的那种吃惊的神色。目瞪口呆地望着妙珠。这是为了想移转他们的注意力，两个人当然都上当，胡雪岩先问：“怎么回事？”“喔，”他忽又放缓了神色，摇摇头说：“没有什么！想起来了，不要紧。”“真正是！”妙珠拍着胸说：“古老爷真会吓人，”胡雪岩对他，当然远比妙珠来得关心，因而追问：“你想起什么？什么事不要紧？”根本无事，如何作答？古应春便信口胡扯：“我想起个很有趣的故事。”胡雪岩啼笑皆非，妙珠却是想想滑稽，这古老爷莫非有痰疾？再看到胡雪岩那副懊恼而无可奈何的模样，不由得“噗哧”一声，忍俊不禁了。这破颜一笑，便至少是安抚了一方，古应春旁观者清，此时若得妙珠的一番柔情蜜意，则百炼钢可以化为绕指柔，因而先抛个眼色，然后指着胡雪岩对妙珠说：“他跟尤五爷谈了一夜，又送他上船，又来看你，这会儿真的累了。你让他好好睡一觉吧！”说完，起身就走，脚在移动，眼睛中不敢放松，一看胡雪岩也要站起，立即回身硬按着他坐下。“朱家人来人往，嘈杂不过。你这两天精神耗费得太多了，难得几样大事都已有了头绪，正该好好息一息，养足了精神，我们明天一起到苏州，转上海。““古老爷是好话！”妙珠从容接口，“一个人，好歹要晓得，好话一定要听。”胡雪岩也实在是倦得眼都要睁不开，勉强撑持在那里，经他们两人这样相劝，一念把握不住，如水就下，浑身劲泄，不但懒得动，连话都懒得说了。看古应春刚要出门，他想起一句话，非说不可，“老古，老古，你等等！”他吃力地说，“老周只怕今天会从苏州回来，如果有啥信息，你赶紧派人来通知我。”“我知道了。你尽管安心在这里休息好了。”
en: Exhausted and irritable, Hu thought her obstinate and unreasonable. He almost wanted to quarrel and let the quarrel end everything. Before he could speak, Gu saw the danger and intervened. “Ah!” He stared at Miaozhu in apparent horror, like a man suddenly remembering some gravely neglected matter. Both fell for the distraction. “What's wrong?” Hu asked first. Gu relaxed, shaking his head. “Nothing. I remember now. It's all right.” Miaozhu patted her chest. “You really do frighten people!” Hu was naturally much more concerned about Gu than she was. “What did you remember? What's all right?” There was nothing to explain, so Gu improvised. “A very amusing story came to mind.” Hu did not know whether to laugh or cry. Miaozhu found it absurd: was Mr Gu subject to some disorder? Seeing Hu's vexed, helpless expression, she burst out laughing. At least one side was now soothed. Gu could see that a little tenderness from her would turn the hardest steel soft. He gave her a glance, then pointed to Hu. “He talked with Master You all night, saw him aboard, and then came to see you. He's truly exhausted. Let him have a proper sleep.” He rose to leave, watching Hu closely. When Hu tried to rise too, Gu turned and firmly pressed him back into his chair. “Zhu's house is full of people coming and going, far too noisy. You've worn yourself out these past few days. Now that several important affairs are taking shape, rest properly and regain your strength. Tomorrow we'll go together to Suzhou and then Shanghai.” “Mr Gu means well,” Miaozhu said calmly. “One should know good advice from bad and listen to the good.” Hu could scarcely keep his eyes open. Under their persuasion, his last resistance gave way like water running downhill. He was too weary even to speak. But as Gu reached the door, he remembered something essential. “Wait, Old Gu. Zhou may return from Suzhou today. If there's any news, send someone to tell me at once.” “I understand. Rest here without worry.”

zh: 等古应春一走，妙珠亲自去绞了一把热毛巾，递到胡雪岩手里，同时问道：“饿不饿？”“饿倒不饿，心里有点发虚。”“不是心里虚，是身子虚。我煨了一罐莲芯粥在那里，你吃一碗，就上床去吧！”一面说，一面便走了开去，不多片刻，阿金捧着一只闽漆托盘，端来了一碗桂花冰糖莲芯粥。胡雪岩本来就爱甜食，那碗粥清腴甘糯，吃完了意有未尽。妙珠仿佛预知他的心意似地，紧接着端来了第二碗。“没有打算你会来，不曾多预备，就只有这一碗了。我马上再炖，等你起来再吃。”妙珠又向：“另外还想吃点啥？好趁早动手。”这样深情款款，胡雪岩心头的樊篱尽撤，看看阿金走得远了，便笑笑说道：“啥也不要，只要你的人！”嘴里说着话，一只手便伸过来拉，妙珠腰肢一扭，翩然避开，带着顽皮的笑容说：“君子动口，小人动手。”胡雪岩一笑而罢，伸过懒腰，站起身来，妙珠便引着他到卧房，房间甚大，却犹未布置妥帖，不过窗帘已经装好，床上衾枕整洁，尽堪安卧，身子一歪，倒在床上，就不想动了。“起来嘛！等我铺床。”“马马虎虎好了。”胡雪岩的眼睛已经合拢，“我不想再动了。”妙珠无奈，叫进阿金来，替他脱靴宽衣，一个身子拨过来拨过去，费了好半天的事，刚把他的头搬到枕上，鼾声已经起了。
en: Once Gu had gone, Miaozhu wrung out a hot towel herself and handed it to Hu. “Are you hungry?” “Not hungry. I feel rather empty inside.” “It's your body that's weak. I've been simmering lotus-seed porridge. Have a bowl, then go to bed.” She left, and soon A’jin brought a bowl on a Fujian lacquer tray: lotus-seed porridge with osmanthus and rock sugar. Hu liked sweet things. It was delicate, rich, sweet and soft, and he wanted more when it was gone. As though anticipating his thought, Miaozhu immediately brought a second bowl. “I didn't expect you, so I made little. This is the last bowl. I'll put more on, ready when you wake. What else would you like? I can begin preparing it early.” Her tenderness swept away his defences. Once A’jin was out of earshot, he smiled. “Nothing else. Only you.” He reached to draw her towards him, but she twisted away lightly. “A gentleman uses words; a small-minded man uses his hands,” she teased. Hu laughed, stretched and rose. Miaozhu led him to a spacious bedroom, not yet fully arranged, but with curtains hung and clean bedding ready. He sank onto the bed and would not move. “Get up a moment so I can make it properly.” “It's good enough.” His eyes were already closing. “I don't want to move.” Helplessly, she called A’jin. Together they removed his boots and loosened his clothes, turning him this way and that with considerable effort. His head had barely reached the pillow before he was snoring.

zh: 他这一觉睡到下午才醒，首先听到的是柔靡的小调，用鼻音低低哼着，转身朝外，从雪白方孔纱帐中望出去，只见妙珠正坐在窗前通头发，发长及腰，一梳子通不到底，不能不抬起又白又腻的一弯手臂，反握发梢，才料理得了。胡雪岩看在眼里，痒在心头，便咳嗽一声，等她揭帐来视，很快地将她一拉。猝不及防的妙珠，恨声说道：“总是这样子蛮来！”等她一放手，她脱身退后，正色而言：“这里地方不同了。”胡雪岩愣了一下，才明白她的意思，是良家妇女了，不同于她们姐妹一起张艳帜的时候。一夜之隔，居然身分不同，然而对一个睡在她床上的男人，说这样的话，不太可笑吗？因此，他不假思索地问了一句：“那么我呢？睡在这里，算是啥名堂？”“问你自己！你不说明白，我只好拿你当客人看。”“客人？”胡雪岩忍不住好笑，“睡在女主人床上的客人！”妙珠也忍不住抿嘴笑了，但很快地又绷起脸来，“难得一次。”她说，“下次再来，就对不起了。”“怎么样？莫非赶我出门？”妙珠词穷不答，只叫阿金舀脸水进来，自己虽也在招呼照料，却总是远远地躲着胡雪岩，深怕他要动手动脚来轻薄似地。这样子见他如见了一条蛇的神情，使得胡雪岩大起反感，便忍不住挖苦她：“真象个人家人的样子了！是不是想造贞节牌坊？”话说得太重，妙珠勃然变色，强自按捺怒气，冷笑着说：“随便你怎么样说好了！总而言之一句话：我的主意打走了，你一天不拿真心出来，我一天饶不了你。你等在那里！自有麻烦来找上你的门。”象要挟，又象恫吓，但更象撒娇，胡雪岩笑道：“你倒说说看，怎么样找我的麻烦？”“不告诉你。”妙珠恨恨地说：“没良心的人，值不得可惜，你看我！总有一天要你讨饶。“
en: He slept until afternoon. The first thing he heard was a soft, languid tune hummed through the nose. Turning towards the room, he looked through the white mesh curtains and saw Miaozhu combing her hair by the window. It reached her waist, too long for a single stroke; she had to lift a smooth white arm and take the ends in her other hand. The sight stirred him. He coughed, and when she lifted the curtain to look, he quickly pulled her towards him. Taken by surprise, she protested, “Always so rough!” When he released her, she stepped back and said seriously, “This is a different place now.” Hu paused, then understood. She was a respectable woman now, no longer keeping a courtesan's house with her sister. Overnight, her status had changed. But was it not absurd to say this to a man lying in her bed? Without thinking, he asked, “Then what am I, sleeping here?” “Ask yourself. Until you explain, I can only treat you as a guest.” “A guest!” He could not help laughing. “A guest sleeping in the hostess's bed!” She too suppressed a smile, then grew stern again. “Just this once. Next time, I'm afraid...” “What? You'll turn me out?” Unable to answer, she called A’jin for washing water. Though she attended him, she kept her distance, as if afraid he would lay hands on her. Her manner, as though facing a snake, offended Hu. He could not resist a taunt. “You really look the respectable woman now! Planning a chastity arch?” The words were harsh. Miaozhu changed colour, restrained her anger and answered with a cold smile. “Say what you like. I've made up my mind: until you show me your true heart, I won't leave you in peace. Wait. Trouble will come to your door.” It sounded like coercion, or a threat, but more than either like a lover's petulance. Hu laughed. “Tell me how you'll trouble me.” “I won't tell you. A heartless man deserves no pity. Just wait. One day you'll beg for mercy.”

zh: 明知是因爱生恨，胡雪岩仍不免哑然失笑，“到底你我有啥解不开的仇？”他问，“你拿我恨成这个样子？”妙珠也是一时冲动，发泄了固然快意，事后却不免失悔。由他这一问，少不得从头想起，也不过几天间的事，象他这样场面上的人，走马章台，不足为奇，如说有人喜欢她，就得量珠聘去，世上哪里有这样的事？置妾虽不比娶妻，也不是一件小事，当然他有他的难处。只为自己一片痴情，都在他身上，相形之下好象显得他薄情，其实他守着他做客人的道理，丝毫不错，怪来怪去，只怪自己一厢情愿，钻到牛角尖里去了。这是有苦说不出委屈，既以自怨，又以自责，更以自惭，那眼泪就止不住了，面朝外坐在妆台边，泪水沾湿了衣襟一大片，也懒得去拭一拭眼。胡雪岩坐在床沿上，是在她身后，看不见她的脸，只觉得她无语兀坐，态度可怪，等走过来一看，方始惊惶，“咦，咦！”他问，“怎么了？伤这么大的心！”“我也想穿了，”妙珠哭过一阵，心境比较开朗，情感不再那么黏滞，“各人有各人的处境，硬凑到一起，也没有意思。回去是决不会回去了，不过，我也不会再嬲住你。”说着，擦一擦眼睛，醒一醒鼻子，走了出去。胡雪岩的心情很矛盾。听她这样的表示，原该有如释重负之感，却反觉得无趣，就坐在妙珠原来的座位上，茫然不知所措。坐又有些坐不往，站起来随便走一走，一定走到窗前，无意中向外一望，恰好看到妙珠，手里拿着一张红笺，上面仿佛有字，这很容易理解，她将那张“胡寓”的门牌取消了。这反使得他怅然若失。但是妙珠两手空空走了进来，不提此事，他也不便先问，搭讪着说：“老古怎么不来？”又问：“几点钟了？”
en: Knowing that love lay beneath the anger, Hu still could not help laughing. “What irreconcilable feud is there between us, that you hate me so?” Miaozhu had spoken impulsively. The release had pleased her, but now regret followed. His question made her reconsider the few days behind them. A man of his position visiting pleasure houses was nothing unusual. If every man who liked her had to bring wealth and marry her, where would that lead? Taking a concubine was less momentous than marrying a wife, but it was no small matter. Naturally, he had difficulties. Her whole heart was fixed on him, making his feelings seem shallow by comparison. Yet as a guest he had observed every proper obligation. She could only blame her own one-sided longing and stubborn pursuit of it. Her distress had no outlet. Self-pity, self-reproach and shame brought tears she could not stop. Sitting at the dressing table, facing away, she let them soak the front of her clothes without even wiping her eyes. Hu, seated behind her on the bed, could not see her face. Her motionless silence seemed strange. Only when he came round did he understand. “Why? What's happened? Why such grief?” After crying, she felt clearer and less entangled in her emotions. “I've thought it through. Everyone has their own circumstances. Forcing ourselves together is pointless. I certainly won't go back, but I won't cling to you any longer either.” She wiped her eyes, blew her nose and left the room. Hu should have felt relieved, yet instead he felt empty. He sat in her chair, bewildered. Unable to remain still, he wandered to the window and happened to see her holding a red sheet with writing on it. The meaning was plain: she had taken down the ‘Hu Residence’ notice. He felt a strange sense of loss. When she returned empty-handed and said nothing, he could hardly ask first. Awkwardly, he said, “Why hasn't Old Gu come? What time is it?”

zh: “快打三点了。”妙珠换了一副态度，平添些周旋的形迹，“还是吃饭，还是先吃些点心？”“午饭、晚饭并在一起吃了！我也不饿。”他说，“哪家馆子好，晚上叫一桌席来，我借你的地方请客。”妙珠似有难色，但终于点点头：“是哪几位客？”“还不就是这几个熟人。主客是朱老大，在他家打搅了好几天，应该表示点意思。”“叫酒席倒现成。”妙珠提醒他说，“如果你是临时起意，要赶紧通知客人。”“是的。我自己去。”于是妙珠伺候他穿上长衫，送他出门。等她关上大门，他才回身去看，果然，那张“胡寓”的朱笺消失了。但深红的四只纸角残迹犹在，好比“家有喜事”的条子刚刚撕去那样，令人兴起一种曲终人散的怅惘。胡雪岩站了好一会，方始回身又走，走出巷口，就是一家笺纸店，他买了一张虎皮笺，看着柜台上的大墨海说：“你们这里哪位字写得好，劳驾替我写两个字。”“喏，”小徒弟指着坐在帐台旁吸水烟的白胡子老头说：“我们老东家的字，呱呱叫！”那个鬓眉皆白的老掌柜，便捧着水烟袋起身，含笑招呼，问明了胡雪岩要写的字样，就着现成的笔墨，一挥而就，年虽衰迈，腕力不弱，一笔魏碑，将“胡寓”二字写得典雅凝重，很够气派。写完裁齐，一客不烦二主，托小徒弟带着浆糊，领他到妙珠家，在门柱上悄悄贴好，然后出巷雇了顶小轿一直来到朱家。
en: “Almost three.” Her manner had changed, acquiring the formality of a hostess entertaining a guest. “Would you like a meal or some refreshments first?” “I'll combine lunch and dinner. I'm not hungry. Which restaurant is good? Order a banquet for this evening. I'll borrow your house to entertain.” She seemed hesitant, but nodded. “Whom are you inviting?” “Our usual friends. Zhu is the guest of honour. We've imposed on him for days. I ought to show my appreciation.” “Ordering food is simple enough. But if you've just decided, you must tell your guests quickly.” “Yes. I'll go myself.” She helped him into his long gown and saw him out. Only after the doors closed did he turn to look. The scarlet notice had indeed gone, though its four dark-red corners still clung to the wood, like the remnants of a festive announcement after the celebration had ended. He felt the melancholy of a finished song and departed company. After standing there a long while, he turned away. At the mouth of the lane was a stationer's. He bought a sheet of tiger-patterned paper and, looking at the large inkstone on the counter, asked, “Who here has a good hand? Would someone write two characters for me?” The apprentice pointed to a white-bearded old man smoking a water pipe beside the accounts desk. “Our old proprietor's writing is splendid.” The old man rose with his pipe and a welcoming smile. Once told what Hu wanted, he took the brush and wrote in a single sweep. Despite his years, his wrist was strong. In the dignified manner of Wei inscriptions, the characters ‘Hu Residence’ looked elegant and imposing. The sheet was trimmed. Keeping the errand with the same shop, Hu asked the apprentice to bring paste, led him to Miaozhu's house and had the notice quietly fixed to the doorpost. Then he hired a small chair and went to Zhu's.

zh: 进门就遇见周一鸣，他是中午到的。因为古应春体恤胡雪岩连日辛苦，特意不让周一鸣去扰他的好梦。此时自是先谈这一件大事，据说何桂清接信颇为高兴，也颇为热心，当时就上督署接洽，由营务处指派一位委员，是个姓奚的候补同知，专责办理此案。奚同知在一两天内，就要到同里来跟跷脚长根见面。“姓奚的，是我极熟的熟人。”俞武成在一旁插嘴，“此人极能干，也极四海，是个好朋友。”“那太好了！”胡雪岩喜不开言，拱手长揖：“大哥，偏劳了！我本来就在发愁，只怕分不开身，如今就都拜托大哥了，我把老周留在这里，听你招呼。”“大家都有分的事，说什么偏劳？”俞武成慨然应承，“我也晓得你这阵子管闲事，耽误了好些正经。这里都交给我好了。你啥时候走？”“明天一定要走了。”胡雪岩趁机邀客，“打搅了朱老大好几天，无以为敬，今天借个地方，专请你们几位叙一叙。这个地方，老古知道，请他陪了去。”“是啥地方？方便不方便？”俞武成说，“我最怕在陌生地方应酬。”“方便，方便！”古应春代为回答：“包你不会拘束。”客是请好了，妙珠那里却还令人放心不下，怕她只有一个阿金，主婢二人，铺排不开，因而又带周一鸣，赶回“胡寓”去照料。
en: He met Zhou as soon as he entered. Zhou had arrived at noon, but Gu, mindful of Hu's exhaustion, had deliberately kept him from disturbing his sleep. Naturally, they discussed the important business first. He Guiqing had been pleased by the letter and had acted energetically, going at once to the governor-general's office. The military affairs office had appointed an expectant assistant prefect named Xi as commissioner in sole charge of the matter. Assistant Prefect Xi would come to Tongli within a day or two to meet Changgen. “I know Xi very well,” Yu put in. “He's exceptionally capable and generous-minded. A good friend.” Hu was delighted and bowed deeply. “Elder Brother, I must trouble you. I was worrying that I couldn't get away. Now I can leave it all to you. I'll keep Old Zhou here to follow your instructions.” “It's everyone's business. Why speak of troubling me?” Yu readily agreed. “I know these other affairs have delayed much of your proper work. Leave this to me. When do you go?” “Tomorrow, without fail.” Hu took the opportunity to invite them. “I've imposed on Zhu for several days and have no way to show my thanks. I've borrowed a place to entertain you tonight. Old Gu knows where. He'll bring you.” “What sort of place? Is it convenient? I dislike entertaining among strangers.” “Entirely convenient,” Gu answered for him. “You won't feel constrained.” The guests were invited, but Hu remained concerned about Miaozhu. With only A’jin to help, might the two women find the arrangements too much? He took Zhou back to ‘Hu Residence’ to assist.

zh: 到了那里一看，才知是过虑。妙珠叫了半副“茶箱”，茶水、烫酒，兼带值席，一起都有人照应。另外馆子里派来三个人，一个厨子、一个下手、一个打杂上菜，请一桌客有这么多人料理，女主人根本清闲无事，在廊上嗑瓜子闲眺，显得十分悠闲。“不过，老周，”妙珠很高兴地说：“你来得正好，要劳你的驾，给我去借几副牌来。”这是“余兴”中少不得的。周一鸣回朱家去借了麻将、牌九、摇缸，刚刚铺设停当，大队人马已经到了。一马当先的古应春，见了女主人就问：“妙珠，刚贴上去，簇簇新的一张条子，为啥又换过？“妙珠一愣，想不通是怎么回事，“什么条子？”她问。“还不是那两个字！你难道不明白。”她是真的不明白。空言相辩无用，所以先不作答，奔出大门一看，虎皮笺上“胡寓”二字，看墨迹已经干了，不是刚贴上去的。“是哪个？”她心里疑惑，莫非是……如果是他，又是什么时候贴上去的？会不会是古应春呢？他是个热心人，也许说动了胡雪岩，回心转意，有些抚慰的表示。但再想一想，便知不然，古应春根本不知道自己跟胡雪岩怄气，撕下门牌这回事，则何由而出此举？照这样看来，还是胡雪岩自己改变了主意。到底把他感动得“降服称臣”，拜倒在石榴裙下。妙珠十分得意，当然，更多的是欣喜和感动。走回里面，只见胡雪岩望着他一笑，这就是证实了是他干的事。只不知道他是什么时候干下的？这样一件小事，都有点神出鬼没，这个人实在厉害！不能不佩服，也不能不小心。心里这样在想，脸上也报以莫逆于心的一笑。古应春看在眼里，越觉好奇心起。只是这样的场合，他要帮着胡雪岩应酬，一时无法去盘根问底。
en: His anxiety proved unnecessary. Miaozhu had hired half a ‘tea-chest’ service to provide tea, warm the wine and wait at table. The restaurant had sent three men as well: a cook, an assistant and a man for odd jobs and serving. With so many attending to one table, the hostess had nothing to do. She stood at ease in the corridor, cracking melon seeds and looking about. “Old Zhou, you've come at just the right time. Would you borrow some gaming sets for me?” These were indispensable to the entertainment. Zhou fetched mahjong tiles, pai gow tiles and a dice-shaking bowl from Zhu's. The arrangements were barely complete when the whole party arrived. Gu led the way. At once he asked Miaozhu, “Why replace a notice that had only just been put up?” She stared. “What notice?” “Those two characters, of course. Surely you know?” She truly did not. Argument was useless, so she ran outside. There stood ‘Hu Residence’ on tiger-patterned paper. The ink was already dry; it had not just been pasted up. Who had done it? Could it be Hu? If so, when? Perhaps Gu, always eager to help, had persuaded Hu to relent and offer this reassurance. But no: Gu knew nothing of the quarrel or her removal of the old sign. Why would he have acted? Hu himself must have changed his mind. At last she had moved him to surrender and bow before her charms. She was triumphant, and happier and more touched still. Back inside, Hu looked at her and smiled, confirming that he had done it. But when? Even in such a small matter, he moved mysteriously. What a formidable man! She must admire him—and be careful. She returned a smile of perfect understanding. Gu saw it and grew more curious, but he had guests to help entertain and could not investigate.

zh: “吃饭还早，”刘不才这时已很起劲地在拉搭子了，“我们怎么玩？请俞老出主意。”“都是自己人，不好当真。”俞武成说，“今天妙珠从良，我们该有点意思，我出个主意，请大家公断。我们推一桌轮庄牌九，赢了的不准落荷包，都拿出来，替妙珠置点啥！”“不必，不必！”胡雪岩急忙辞谢：“没有这个规矩。”大家都赞成，只有胡雪岩坚辞不允，俞武成心直口快，便即问道：“老胡，你是不是怕我们扫了你的面子？”“大哥！”胡雪岩觉得他的话不中听，但不能不表示惶恐，“你怎么说这话？我只好不响了。”“对！”俞武成笑道：“不是我这样子说，没有办法叫你不开口。来，来，我痴长两岁，第一个庄该我。”这桌牌九，味道特别，大家都想输几文，让妙珠有点好处，结果反而扯平了，四个庄，俞武成、刘不才、古应春、杨凤毛分别推完，结帐只多了两百五十两银子。“这不够！再来！”俞武成掳过牌来洗着，“这一下推小的，大家放开手打。”于是下风出手都不能太少，台面上有一千六百两银子，掷骰分牌，他看了一下，扣住牌不响，三门翻牌，点子都不小，俞武成轻轻将牌一掀，一对宝子，统吃。“够了，够了！我替妙珠谢谢。”俞武成将牌一推，拿银票集中在桌子中间，笑盈盈地站起身来。一方牌九只推一条便散场，刘不才赌了这么多年，还是第一回见过这种事。输钱还在其次，赌瘾被勾了起来，未免难受，但亦无可奈何，只能罢手。古应春的感想不同，“俞老真是快人快事！”他说，“我就佩服这种爽快的性子。”
en: “It's early for dinner,” Liu said, already eagerly gathering players. “What shall we play? Let Elder Yu decide.” “We're all friends. We mustn't take it seriously. Today Miaozhu has left her old life, and we ought to make a gesture. Let everyone judge my proposal: rotating banks at pai gow, with no winnings pocketed. Everything goes towards buying her something.” Hu hastily declined. “There's no such custom!” Everyone else approved, but he continued to refuse. Bluntly, Yu asked, “Old Hu, are you afraid we'll make you lose face?” Hu disliked the words, but had to show alarm. “Elder Brother, how can you say that? I can only be silent now.” “Exactly!” Yu laughed. “Nothing else would stop your objections. I'm a little older, so I'll take the first bank.” It was an unusual game. Everyone wanted to lose a little for Miaozhu's benefit, and the result was almost a balance. When Yu, Liu, Gu and Yang had each banked, only two hundred and fifty taels remained in profit. “Not enough. Again!” Yu gathered the tiles and shuffled. “The small game this time. Bet freely.” The players could hardly make small wagers now. There were sixteen hundred taels on the table. Yu threw the dice and dealt, glanced at his tiles, then kept them face down without a word. The three gates revealed respectable hands. He turned his over lightly: a pair, beating them all. “Enough! I thank you for Miaozhu.” He pushed the tiles away, gathered the banknotes in the centre and rose smiling. In all Liu's years of gambling, he had never seen a set of pai gow end after a single deal. Losing was secondary; his appetite had been roused and left unsatisfied. But he could only stop. Gu felt differently. “Elder Yu acts as briskly as he speaks. That's the spirit I admire.”

zh: 俞武成本来就觉得得意，听古应春这一说，越发有兴，不假思索地大声说道：“今天我们索性再做件痛快的事。我一说，大家赞成，不过，老胡不准开口。““何以不准我开口？”胡雪岩笑着抗议。“怕你煞风景……”俞武成刚说了这一句，古应春已猜到他的心里，深怕一个说出口，一个有推托，好事变成僵局，所以急忙拦在前面说：“俞老，俞老！你请过来。”拉到旁边一问，果不其然，俞武成就趁此刻，要为胡雪岩与妙珠撮合，现成的酒席，便是喜筵，贺客贺礼，也都来了。办了喜事，胡雪岩明天好回苏州去干正经。“俞老，你的美意，我那位小爷叔一定感激。不过，家家有本难念的经，他到底有何难处，还不晓得。你老的一句话，重似千金，说出来，他不能说个不字，但心里如果有什么嘀咕，想来你也不愿意。交朋友，总也彼此丝毫无憾，你说是不是呢？”“丝毫无憾”这句话，俞武成听不懂，但他的意思是很容易明白的。仔细想一想，自己有点冒失，说出话来，收不回去，面子上下不来，岂非自讨没趣？这样想着，便对古应春油然而生敬服之心。“不错，不错。老古你想得周到，如今，你看这件事怎么办？”古应春知道他好热闹，更知道他的性情是那种自以为是好意，便不许人不受的纨袴脾气。再细想一想胡雪岩的态度，对妙珠已经回心转意好事有望，便答应由他去作个探问。
en: Already pleased with himself, Yu grew more excited at the praise. Without thinking, he announced, “Let's do another fine, decisive thing today. Once I say it, everyone will agree. But Old Hu mustn't speak.” “Why not?” Hu protested with a smile. “You might spoil the occasion.” Gu had already guessed his intention. Afraid that Yu would speak and Hu refuse, turning a happy plan into a deadlock, he hurried to intervene. “Elder Yu, come here a moment.” Drawing him aside, he found he was right. Yu meant to unite Hu and Miaozhu at once. The banquet was ready to serve as their wedding feast; the guests and gifts were there too. With the marriage settled, Hu could return to Suzhou tomorrow and attend to business. “Little Uncle will certainly appreciate your kindness. But every household has its own difficult scripture. We don't yet know his troubles. Your word carries great weight. Once you've spoken, he cannot refuse. Yet you wouldn't want him to harbour private misgivings. Friends should leave one another no cause for regret. Don't you agree?” Yu did not understand the formal phrase, but grasped the meaning readily. On reflection, he had been rash. Once spoken, the words could not be recalled; if matters went wrong, his own dignity would suffer. He felt a new respect for Gu. “Quite right. You've thought it through. What should we do?” Gu knew Yu's love of excitement, and his spoilt young master's belief that a well-meant offer must never be refused. Reflecting that Hu had softened towards Miaozhu and a happy outcome seemed possible, he agreed to inquire privately.

zh: 私下一谈，胡雪岩的答复是古应春再也想下到的，“我已经叫老周接妙珍来了。”他说：“俞老一开口，我就懂了，既然如此，回头就烦你们两位跟妙珍谈一谈，什么都好答应，只有一样：不能老住在外面。”“小爷叔！”古应春楞了一下说：“我晓得你意思已经活动了，不想变得这么快？是怎么想了一想？”男女间事，无理可喻，胡雪岩的改变心意，是决定于重新贴上“胡寓”门牌的那一刻，而到底又是什么原因让他决定贴上“胡寓”的门牌，是为了妙珠忽作悬崖勒马之计而受了感动，还是一时兴起？已莫可究诘。不过，他是个不肯欺心的人，既然有此决定，即令不为人知，亦不可相负。至于趁今天纳宠，无非不愿辜负朋友的好意，乐得“凑兴”。感到兴趣的，自然不止俞武成和古应春，未吃喜酒，先闹新房，都挤在妙珠屋中，欢然谐笑。等妙珍一到，俞武成和古应春“做媒”，代为谈判条件，问她有何要求？“我没有要求，这是件好事，我只有高兴。不过，我总得问问妙珠的意思。”这是理所当然的，便让她们姐妹密谈。妙珍的意思，怕胡雪岩将来会变心，要他拿出一笔钱来，以防人老珠黄，后半辈子的衣食可以无忧。“你心里要放明白，不是我在打什么主意。初出来那两年的债务，总算弄清楚了，我不想一个钱的好处，他那笔钱拿出来，用你的户名去存去放，折子仍旧交给你。”妙珍又说，“我们姐妹一场，我完全是为你着想。”“那就跟他要三千银子好了。”妙珠的身价，应该不止三千两。不过这桩喜事，与一般情形不同，妙珍也就不便再多劝。把话转到古应春那里，他不需征询胡雪岩的意见，便代为答应了下来，当时向这一晌掌管着胡雪岩的财务的刘不才，如数要足银票，用个红封袋套好，封签上写明“奁仪”，交了给妙珍。妙珍再转交妙珠，她却不肯收，送给姐姐，作为敬意。妙珍无论如何不要，姐妹俩推让了半天，最后作为妙珠托她代为放息，妙珍才收下那个“红包”。
en: Hu's answer astonished him. “I've already sent Zhou to fetch Miaozhen. As soon as Elder Yu spoke, I understood. Since things have reached this point, you two can discuss it with her when she comes. I'll agree to anything, with one exception: she cannot be left living away from me indefinitely.” “Little Uncle!” Gu paused in surprise. “I knew you were wavering, but not that you'd change so quickly. What made you decide?” There was no reasoning out affairs between men and women. Hu had made his choice when he replaced the ‘Hu Residence’ notice. Why he had done that—whether moved by Miaozhu's sudden drawing back, or by a passing impulse—could no longer be disentangled. But he would not deceive his own conscience. Having decided, he could not betray that decision even if nobody knew of it. Taking her as his concubine today merely meant accepting his friends' goodwill and joining in the pleasure of the occasion. Yu and Gu were not the only delighted ones. Before the wedding wine was drunk, the guests were already crowding into Miaozhu's room with cheerful bridal jokes. When Miaozhen arrived, Yu and Gu acted as matchmakers and asked what terms she required. “None. It's a good thing, and I'm only happy. But I must ask Miaozhu what she wants.” Naturally, the sisters were allowed a private talk. Miaozhen feared that Hu might one day tire of her sister. He should provide money now to secure her later years, when youth and beauty had gone. “Understand me: I'm not scheming for myself. The debts from our first two years in the trade are finally cleared. I don't want a single coin. His money can be deposited or lent out in your name, and you keep the passbook. You're my sister. I'm thinking only of you.” “Then ask for three thousand taels.” Miaozhu's value should have been greater, but this marriage differed from the usual arrangement, and Miaozhen would not press her. Gu accepted the request without consulting Hu. He obtained the full amount in banknotes from Liu, who had lately been managing Hu's funds, put them in a red envelope labelled ‘Bridal Gift’, and handed it to Miaozhen. When she passed it to Miaozhu, the younger sister refused it and offered it to her elder sister in gratitude. Miaozhen would not accept. After much mutual insistence, she finally took it on the understanding that she would lend it at interest on Miaozhu's behalf.

zh: 酒阑人散，妙珠方得有机会跟胡雪岩说话。只是原有无数语言，迫不及待地想倾吐，而到了此时，反觉无从说起。望着高烧的红烛，回想这两天的波折，心里不辨是悲，是喜，是感慨，还是感激——感激日日在念经礼拜的白衣大士，菩萨有灵，终于如愿以偿。胡雪岩的心思也跟她差不多，在绯色的光晕中，有着如梦似幻的感觉，凝视着镜中的宜喜宜嗔春风面，自不免兴奋而得意，但想到在苏州的芙蓉，不由得又生歉意。就这样心潮起伏，便想不起该怎么找两句话来跟妙珠说了。“洞房”中是出奇地沉寂，寂静得灯花爆裂的声音都听得见。这使得炒珠大起警觉，也可以说是大起疑虑，如此良宵，决不该有这样清冷的光景，于是觉得有句话非说不可。“你懊侮了是不是？”她问。胡雪岩很诧异，“懊悔什么？”他反问一句。“懊悔不该自己贴上‘胡寓’那张条子？”“没有这话！我做事从来不懊悔的。”妙珠默然。这总算是一种安慰，但究不知他真心如何？也许口中否认，心里真有悔意。那样子倒是自己该懊悔孟浪了。生米已经煮成熟饭，却还未了咽。她心里在想，错了一步，错不得第二步，宁可落下笑柄，也不能自误一辈子，无论如何得要试出他的真心来。一念到此，立刻有了计较。要试别人的真心，先得自己表示真心，她毫不迟疑地打开一只描金皮箱，从箱底取出首饰箱来，开锁揭盖，送到胡雪岩面前。
en: Only when the drinking ended and the guests dispersed could Miaozhu speak with Hu. She had countless things to say, yet now did not know where to begin. Watching the tall red candles, she thought of the past two days' upheavals. Was she sad, joyful, moved or grateful? Grateful, surely, to the White-Robed Bodhisattva before whom she prayed every day. The compassionate power had answered her wish at last. Hu's feelings were much the same. In the crimson glow, everything seemed dreamlike. The lively face reflected in the mirror, equally lovely in pleasure and displeasure, filled him with excitement and pride. Then he thought of Furong in Suzhou and felt guilty. His emotions shifted so much that he too could find nothing to say. The bridal chamber was extraordinarily quiet; even the crackling candlewicks could be heard. Miaozhu became alert, then suspicious. Such a night should not be so cold and silent. She had to ask. “You regret it, don't you?” “Regret what?” he asked in surprise. “Putting up ‘Hu Residence’ yourself.” “Nothing of the sort. I never regret what I do.” She fell silent. It was some comfort, but what were his true feelings? Perhaps he denied regret while feeling it. Then she ought to regret her own rashness. The rice was cooked, but not yet swallowed. One false step must not lead to another. Better become a laughingstock than ruin her whole life. She must test his heart. The way came to her at once: to test another's sincerity, she must first show her own. Without hesitation, she opened a gilded leather trunk, took the jewel box from its bottom, unlocked it and brought it to Hu.

zh: 箱子里有玉镯、宝石、戒指、珠花、金镑、珈南香手串，都用新棉花包着，此时一样一样揭开来放在桌上，五光十色，令人目眩。胡雪岩不解所谓，忍不住问道：“你这样献宝干什么？”“我的私房都在这里。喏，你看！”她捡起一扣存折，递给胡雪岩。“你自己的东西，用不着给我看！”他不着存折，顺手抛在首饰箱里。“这些首饰，我自己估一估，值两万银子。你看呢？”“我不大懂。”胡雪岩说：“快收起来！财不露白。如果这时候外面有个贼在偷看，以后就危险了。”“ 不要紧的！这房子严密得很，围墙极高，不怕贼来。”妙珠略停一下，回入正题：“我留着这些东西无用，说不定如你所说，叫贼偷了去，反害得我心疼，不如交了给你。”“交给我做什么？”“咦！那还不是随便你，做生意派点本钱也是好的。”听得这两句话，胡雪岩的感想极多，但最后却是笑了出来，想到“唱本”上的故事：公子落难，花园赠金，大魁天下，奉旨归娶。看起来，妙珠多少也有这样子的想法。
en: Inside were jade bangles, gems, rings, pearl ornaments, gold sovereigns and fragrant aloeswood beads, each wrapped in fresh cotton. As she uncovered them one by one and placed them on the table, their colours dazzled the eye. Hu did not understand. “Why are you showing off your treasures?” “These are all my private savings. Look.” She picked up a passbook and handed it to him. “Your own belongings needn't be shown to me.” Without looking, he tossed it back into the jewel box. “I estimate the jewellery at twenty thousand taels. What do you think?” “I'm no expert. Put it away quickly. Wealth shouldn't be displayed. If a thief were watching outside, there could be trouble later.” “Don't worry. The house is secure and the walls very high.” After a pause she came to the point. “I have no use for these things. Perhaps, as you say, a thief will steal them and leave me heartbroken. Better give them to you.” “What for?” “Whatever you like. They could provide some capital for your business.” Hu had many feelings at this, but finally laughed. He thought of the stories in songbooks: a young gentleman fallen on hard times, a gift of gold in a garden, triumph in the examinations, then an imperial command to return and marry his benefactress. Miaozhu seemed to harbour some such notion.

zh: 这一笑，显得有些轻侮，妙珠微感不悦，正色说道：“我是诚心诚意的正经话。”“我晓得你是诚心诚意。可惜，”胡雪岩想了想，还是将那句话说了出来：“你这番诚心，用错了地方。”“怎么呢？诚心待人还会错？”“本心不错，用得不得当。你要遇见一个肯上进的穷书生就好了，将来不说中状元，进京赶考中个进士好了，明媒正娶，还挣副诰封给你。那有多好？”“我不稀罕。只要……”“只要怎么样？”“只要……”妙珠很吃力地说：“只要你不变心就好了。”胡雪岩默然。觉得所遇到过的几个女子，以妙珠用心最苦，胁之以死，动之以利，先怕嫁不成，嫁成了又怕人变心，心眼儿这么多，将来怕难得相处。他的心里很矛盾，有畏惧也有怜惜，因而既想设法将刚结上的红丝剪断，却又觉得割舍不下，就这踌躇莫决之际，听得妙珠幽幽地叹了口气。“唉！嫁鸡随鸡，嫁狗随狗，我也跟你一样，做事不会懊悔的。将来都看你！反正不管怎么样，我姓胡是姓定了。”听得出来，这是从心底掏出来的真话。她有这样的表示，自己便再无别的主意好打。但是胡雪岩也警觉到，此时不宜轻许诺言，宜乎硬起心肠来，言明在先。
en: The laugh seemed slightly contemptuous. A little hurt, she said seriously, “I mean it sincerely.” “I know. Unfortunately...” He considered, then said what he had been thinking. “Your sincerity has found the wrong object.” “How can sincerity towards someone be wrong?” “The intention is good; its use is mistaken. You should have met an ambitious, poor scholar. Even if he didn't finish first in the empire, he might go to the capital and gain the jinshi degree. Then he could marry you properly as his wife and earn you an imperial title. How fine that would be.” “I don't care for that. All I want...” “What?” With difficulty, she answered, “For you not to change your heart.” Hu was silent. Of all the women he had known, Miaozhu had taken the greatest pains: first threatening death, then appealing with wealth; first fearing she could not marry him, then fearing that he would change once she had. With so many calculations, she might be hard to live with. He felt both apprehension and pity. Part of him wanted to cut the red thread they had just tied, yet he could not bear to part with her. While he hesitated, she sighed softly. “Marry a cock, follow the cock; marry a dog, follow the dog. Like you, I won't regret what I've done. The future rests with you. Whatever happens, my name is Hu now.” The words came from her heart. After that declaration, he could entertain no other plan. Yet he realized that easy promises would be unwise. He must harden himself and speak plainly first.

zh: “你这样一片诚心待我，我怎么肯变心。不过，我有为难之处，你也该体谅。将来有不得不让你委屈的地方，你肯不肯咬起牙关来承受？”妙珠咬一咬牙，答了一个字：“肯！”“那就好了。什么委屈，这时候也不必去说它，总之将心比心，到时候你肯为我设想，就晓得我要你受那种委屈，也是无奈。”这番话暧昧难明，妙珠认为必须问个清楚：“你倒说说看，是啥委屈？让我心里也好有个预备。““譬如说，我明天一早就要走了，丢下你一个人在这里，岂不是委屈了你？”“象这样，不算委屈。”妙珠又问：“还有呢？”“还有？”胡雪岩摇摇头，“一时无比说起。反正都是这种事出无奈的情形。我们先谈明天，我起了以后，你怎么样？”“自然是关起门来过日子。”这样的答复，是可以意料得到的。但说出口来，有声音灌入耳中，少不得要想一想，这一想，便有疑问了。“你是过惯了热闹日子的，一个人清清冷冷，熬得下来吗？”话问得很坦率，也很实在，可是妙珠却觉得不中听，因而语声中便有不服气的意味：“你看着好了，看我熬得下来，熬不下来？”熬不下来又如何？胡雪岩心里在想，将来红杏出墙丢了自己的面子。这件事非同小可，必得好好想个办法。生米已经煮成熟饭，说不算也不行，那就只有一条路好走。
en: “With such sincerity towards me, how could I change? But I have difficulties too, and you must understand them. If circumstances force me to make you bear some hardship, will you grit your teeth and accept it?” Miaozhu clenched her teeth and gave one word: “Yes.” “Good. We needn't discuss what hardships now. Put yourself in my place when the time comes, and you'll understand that I have no choice.” The words were too vague. She had to ask. “Tell me what you mean, so I can prepare myself.” “For instance, I must leave early tomorrow and leave you alone here. Won't that be hard on you?” “That doesn't count. What else?” He shook his head. “I can't list everything now. They will be things beyond my control. Let's talk about tomorrow. Once I've left, what will you do?” “Close my doors and live quietly, of course.” He could have predicted that answer. Hearing it aloud, however, made him consider it, and a question followed. “You're used to a lively life. Can you endure the loneliness?” It was a frank, practical question, but she disliked it. Defiance entered her voice. “Wait and see whether I can.” And if she could not? Hu thought. An affair would disgrace him. This was serious; he must find a sound arrangement. The rice was already cooked. He could not pretend otherwise. There was only one course.

zh: 对这一重姻缘，一直优柔寡断、访煌游移、自己都不知道如何是好的胡雪岩，恢复了他的明快果断的性格，“妙珠！”他用毫不含糊的语气说：“这些东西你自己先收起来，有机会我替你做点‘小货’，是你的私房，我决不来动你，至于丢你一个人在这里，我也不放心，你等我明天一走，就收拾收拾行李，我再来接你，我想把你摆在上海。”到底有了个明确的了断！转弯抹角，终于逼出了他心里的话，妙珠大为欣慰。但是，他还有个芙蓉在那里，又将作何处置？“此刻在苏州的‘那一个’呢？”“你是说芙蓉？”胡雪岩毫不迟疑地答道：“我拿她摆在湖州。”这就很容易明白了，他预备立三个“门口”，除了杭州在老家，上海、湖州各一处。上海是繁华之地，而且要做生意，就碍常住上海，比较上以自己的处境最优越。妙珠苦心设计，做作得太久，这时候再也不愿掩饰她的真情，收好她的首饰箱往床里枕头边一放，随即便贴住他的身子坐下，两手环抱，抱住他的上半身，将脸偎依在他肩头，深深地吸着气，显得极其满足恬适似地。
en: After all his indecision over this marriage, Hu recovered his usual clarity and firmness. “Miaozhu, put these things away for now. When there's an opportunity, I'll do some small trading for you. They are your private assets; I won't touch them for myself. As for leaving you here alone, I can't feel easy about that either. Once I go tomorrow, begin packing. I'll come back for you. I mean to settle you in Shanghai.” At last there was a definite decision. After so many twists, she had drawn out his real intention, and was deeply relieved. But there was still Furong. What would become of her? “And the one in Suzhou?” “You mean Furong?” He answered without hesitation. “I'll settle her in Huzhou.” It was plain enough to her. He meant to establish three households: the old family home in Hangzhou, and others in Shanghai and Huzhou. Shanghai was prosperous, and business would keep him there often. Her position was the best of the three. She had schemed and acted for too long to conceal her true feelings any more. Putting away her jewel box beside the pillows, she sat close against him, wrapped both arms round his upper body, laid her face against his shoulder and drew a deep breath, looking utterly content and at peace.
